description: This file defines the 'Zend_XmlRpc_Client_IntrospectException' class, which extends 'Zend_XmlRpc_Client_Exception'. It is used within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC client component, specifically for exceptions related to introspection errors.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_IntrospectException
classes.description: An exception class thrown by Zend_XmlRpc_Client_Introspection on errors, extending Zend_XmlRpc_Client_Exception.
